blocks.en: How much do I want to advance, grow, and evolve?
blocks.ro: Cât de mult vreau să înaintez, să cresc și să evoluez?

blocks.en: Advancement, commonly referred to today as progress, is defined as a forward-going movement toward elevating the self into a higher version of oneself or of human society.
blocks.ro: Înaintarea, numită astăzi de obicei progres, este definită drept o mișcare înainte, către ridicarea sinelui la o versiune superioară a propriei persoane sau a societății umane.

blocks.en: Evolution is deeper than advancement: it relates strongly to the elevation of the inner and spiritual powers that constitute the human being.
blocks.ro: Evoluția este mai profundă decât înaintarea: ea are o strânsă legătură cu înălțarea puterilor lăuntrice și spirituale care alcătuiesc ființa umană.

blocks.en: We might progress in our society, but not evolve. As Zevists, we seek both progress and evolution.
blocks.ro: Putem progresa în societatea noastră fără a evolua. Ca Zeviști, căutăm atât progresul, cât și evoluția.

blocks.en: A society can be considerably advanced, but not evolved. However, the society and the being that are evolved will, sooner or later, advance themselves.
blocks.ro: O societate poate fi considerabil de avansată fără a fi evoluată. Însă societatea și ființa care sunt evoluate vor progresa, mai devreme sau mai târziu.

blocks.en: Great is the plague when progress is high but evolution is low.
blocks.ro: Mare este năpasta atunci când progresul este ridicat, dar evoluția este scăzută.

blocks.en: Every human being should walk both paths, as we have two legs.
blocks.ro: Fiecare ființă umană ar trebui să urmeze ambele căi, așa cum avem două picioare.

blocks.en: Ancient Greek Code Prayer
blocks.ro: Rugăciunea codului în greaca veche

blocks.en: Πρόοδος καὶ Ἐξέλιξις
blocks.ro: Πρόοδος καὶ Ἐξέλιξις

blocks.en: Ὦ Σάτυα, ἄγε ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ προόδῳ καὶ τῇ τοῦ πνεύματος ἐξελίξει·
blocks.ro: Ὦ Σάτυα, ἄγε ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ προόδῳ καὶ τῇ τοῦ πνεύματος ἐξελίξει·

blocks.en: δίδαξον ἡμᾶς ἀμφοτέρας τὰς ὁδοὺς ὁμοῦ βαδίζειν.
blocks.ro: δίδαξον ἡμᾶς ἀμφοτέρας τὰς ὁδοὺς ὁμοῦ βαδίζειν.

blocks.en: Transliteration
blocks.ro: Transliterare

blocks.en: Ō Satya, age hēmas en tēi proodōi kai tēi tou pneumatos exelixei; didaxon hēmas amphoteras tas hodous homou badizein.
blocks.ro: Ō Satya, age hēmas en tēi proodōi kai tēi tou pneumatos exelixei; didaxon hēmas amphoteras tas hodous homou badizein.

blocks.en: Meaning
blocks.ro: Sens

blocks.en: New Ancient Greek prayer composed for this page. This newly composed prayer asks Satya to unite outward progress with inward evolution.
blocks.ro: Rugăciune nouă în greaca veche, compusă pentru această pagină. Această rugăciune nou compusă îi cere lui Satya să unească progresul exterior cu evoluția lăuntrică.

blocks.en: The Ethic in Ancient Greek
blocks.ro: Principiul etic în greaca veche

blocks.en: Πόσον βούλομαι προκόπτειν, αὐξάνεσθαι καὶ ἐξελίσσεσθαι;
blocks.ro: Πόσον βούλομαι προκόπτειν, αὐξάνεσθαι καὶ ἐξελίσσεσθαι;

blocks.en: Ἡ πρόοδος, ἣν νῦν οὕτως ὀνομάζουσιν, κίνησίς ἐστιν εἰς τὸ πρόσθεν, πρὸς ὑψηλοτέραν ἑαυτοῦ ἢ τῆς ἀνθρωπίνης κοινωνίας μορφὴν ἀνάγουσα.
blocks.ro: Ἡ πρόοδος, ἣν νῦν οὕτως ὀνομάζουσιν, κίνησίς ἐστιν εἰς τὸ πρόσθεν, πρὸς ὑψηλοτέραν ἑαυτοῦ ἢ τῆς ἀνθρωπίνης κοινωνίας μορφὴν ἀνάγουσα.

blocks.en: Ἡ δὲ ἐξέλιξις βαθύτερά ἐστι τῆς προόδου· τὰς ἐντὸς καὶ πνευματικὰς δυνάμεις, αἳ τὸν ἄνθρωπον συνιστᾶσιν, ἀνυψοῖ.
blocks.ro: Ἡ δὲ ἐξέλιξις βαθύτερά ἐστι τῆς προόδου· τὰς ἐντὸς καὶ πνευματικὰς δυνάμεις, αἳ τὸν ἄνθρωπον συνιστᾶσιν, ἀνυψοῖ.

blocks.en: Ἐν τῇ κοινωνίᾳ προκόπτειν μὲν δυνάμεθα, μὴ ἐξελίσσεσθαι δέ· ἡμεῖς δὲ οἱ Ζευϊσταὶ ἀμφότερα ζητοῦμεν.
blocks.ro: Ἐν τῇ κοινωνίᾳ προκόπτειν μὲν δυνάμεθα, μὴ ἐξελίσσεσθαι δέ· ἡμεῖς δὲ οἱ Ζευϊσταὶ ἀμφότερα ζητοῦμεν.

blocks.en: Κοινωνία σφόδρα προκεκοφυῖα ἀνεξέλικτος εἶναι δύναται· ἡ δὲ κοινωνία καὶ τὸ ὂν τὰ ἐξελιγμένα ὕστερον καὶ προκόψει.
blocks.ro: Κοινωνία σφόδρα προκεκοφυῖα ἀνεξέλικτος εἶναι δύναται· ἡ δὲ κοινωνία καὶ τὸ ὂν τὰ ἐξελιγμένα ὕστερον καὶ προκόψει.

blocks.en: Μεγάλη νόσος ὅταν ἡ μὲν πρόοδος ὑψηλή, ἡ δ᾽ ἐξέλιξις ταπεινή.
blocks.ro: Μεγάλη νόσος ὅταν ἡ μὲν πρόοδος ὑψηλή, ἡ δ᾽ ἐξέλιξις ταπεινή.

blocks.en: Δύο ὁδοὺς βαδιστέον παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ, ὥσπερ δυσὶ ποσὶ βαδίζει.
blocks.ro: Δύο ὁδοὺς βαδιστέον παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ, ὥσπερ δυσὶ ποσὶ βαδίζει.

blocks.en: Proodos kai Exelixis · Transliteration
blocks.ro: Proodos kai Exelixis · Transliterare

blocks.en: Poson boulomai prokoptein, auxanesthai kai exelissesthai;
blocks.ro: Poson boulomai prokoptein, auxanesthai kai exelissesthai;

blocks.en: Hē proodos, hēn nyn houtōs onomazousin, kinēsis estin eis to prosthen, pros hypsēloteran heautou ē tēs anthrōpinēs koinōnias morphēn anagousa.
blocks.ro: Hē proodos, hēn nyn houtōs onomazousin, kinēsis estin eis to prosthen, pros hypsēloteran heautou ē tēs anthrōpinēs koinōnias morphēn anagousa.

blocks.en: Hē de exelixis bathytera esti tēs proodou; tas entos kai pneumatikas dynameis, hai ton anthrōpon synistasin, anypsoi.
blocks.ro: Hē de exelixis bathytera esti tēs proodou; tas entos kai pneumatikas dynameis, hai ton anthrōpon synistasin, anypsoi.

blocks.en: En tēi koinōniai prokoptein men dynametha, mē exelissesthai de; hēmeis de hoi Zeuistai amphotera zētoumen.
blocks.ro: En tēi koinōniai prokoptein men dynametha, mē exelissesthai de; hēmeis de hoi Zeuistai amphotera zētoumen.

blocks.en: Koinōnia sphodra prokekophyia anexeliktos einai dynatai; hē de koinōnia kai to on ta exeligmena hysteron kai prokopsei.
blocks.ro: Koinōnia sphodra prokekophyia anexeliktos einai dynatai; hē de koinōnia kai to on ta exeligmena hysteron kai prokopsei.

blocks.en: Megalē nosos hotan hē men proodos hypsēlē, hē d᾽ exelixis tapeinē.
blocks.ro: Megalē nosos hotan hē men proodos hypsēlē, hē d᾽ exelixis tapeinē.

blocks.en: Dyo hodous badisteon panti anthrōpōi, hōsper dysi posi badizei.
blocks.ro: Dyo hodous badisteon panti anthrōpōi, hōsper dysi posi badizei.
